cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor; absent when no further reactions are known.

limit.description: Maximum number of reaction records to return.

subject.description: AT-URI of the review whose reactions to list, in `community.lexicon.media.book.review` or `buzz.bookhive.book`.

description: List the emoji reactions to one review, most recent first. `subject` must name a review: a `community.lexicon.media.book.review` record, or the `buzz.bookhive.book` record a reader's review lives in. Any other record is `InvalidRequest` — the reaction bar under a review is the only thing this query serves. Club reactions are deliberately absent: they live inside the club's space, under the club's own access rule, and are read through it rather than through a public index.
